misprints.note: The full stop after the abbreviation m is missing in the print.
Late or unusual 2nd singular form, kept as printed.

uncertain.note: The genitive ending may carry a rough breathing (ὕος) in the print, but the mark is unclear. Transcribed as ύος.
Printed as roman 'o.' (Swedish och), not ὁ. Transcribed as roman o.
The diacritic on the initial iota is small. Read as a smooth breathing.
